# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$98-109)**
- WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome stand with a tilting 15W Qi2 pad, fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and an AirPods pad on the base.
- It works in landscape for StandBy mode, comes with a 36W power supply, and has a 2-year warranty.
- WIRED lists it at about $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Prices change, so check at checkout.
- Buy links are in the [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It has 25W Qi2 for iPhone and a heavy base that lets you lift the phone off one-handed.
- It has a 6.6 ft cable, but no power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25).
- See the [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) for the buy link.

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (~$40-80)**
- It is the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has tested. It charges at 15W and includes a charger and cable.
- The Apple Watch charger detaches, which is handy for travel. The warranty is only 1 year.
- WIRED listed it at $40 on Amazon, but that is a sale price that may have changed. Buy via the [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Best foldable for desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It lifts the phone over 70mm and has a 160° viewing angle.
- It includes a 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs. It weighs 399g, which is heavier than rivals.
- Read the [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html), which links to retailers.

**Best for travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) (~$80 on sale)**
- It folds slim, charges the phone at 15W, and has a 2-year warranty. It was 27% off on Amazon and Anker's site per [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/).

**Best if you want cooling: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W**
- It has an active cooling fan, which can be turned off at night, and a 50W adapter included. WIRED rates it the fastest travel option.
- [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) lists it at $99.99, or about $82 with code PARTNER18. That is an affiliate link that opens ESR's official store at no extra cost to you.
- The full 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.

## Which to pick
- **Most people:** the Belkin. It is well-rounded and often discounted.
- **Tightest budget:** the ESR 15W model.
- **iPhone 16 or 17 and you want max speed:** the Nomad or Satechi. WIRED notes that 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight.
- **Frequent traveler:** the Anker MagGo or Satechi.

Your AirPods case must support wireless charging, as AirPods Pro and AirPods with a wireless case do, or the base pad won't work.
